review:
A 50-line fruit game on 5x5 – strawberries, lemons and lucky sevens – with more rows and more potential line wins than a classic 5x3.

In the progressive free spins, scatters add more games and wilds grow bigger, potentially into a full 5x5 block. A grid full of wilds is how the 5,000x max can happen. 96.51% RTP. A nice middle ground between retro and modern.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
